prompt.en: As Head of the Commonwealth, what does the Sovereign do?
prompt.fr: En tant que chef du Commonwealth, que fait le souverain ou la souveraine?

options.en: Links Canada with other member nations that work together on social, economic and cultural progress.
options.fr: Fait le lien entre le Canada et les autres pays membres qui collaborent au progrès social, économique et culturel.

options.en: Heads the United Nations, where Canadians have served on many peacekeeping missions in Egypt, Cyprus and Haiti.
options.fr: Dirige les Nations Unies, où des Canadiens ont servi dans de nombreuses missions de paix en Égypte, à Chypre et en Haïti.

options.en: Commands the navy, army and air force of every member country, as their commander-in-chief.
options.fr: Commande la marine, l'armée de terre et l'aviation de chaque pays membre, à titre de commandant en chef.

options.en: Makes the laws for the member countries that are still monarchies, such as Australia and New Zealand.
options.fr: Fait les lois des pays membres qui sont encore des monarchies, comme l'Australie et la Nouvelle-Zélande.

explanation.en: The Commonwealth is a group of countries that cooperate. It is not the United Nations, and its members are not all monarchies. The Sovereign is its head and connects Canada to the other members.
explanation.fr: Le Commonwealth est un groupe de pays qui coopèrent. Ce ne sont pas les Nations Unies, et ses membres ne sont pas tous des monarchies. Le souverain ou la souveraine en est le chef et relie le Canada aux autres membres.

source.quote: As Head of the Commonwealth, the Sovereign links Canada to 53 other nations that cooperate to advance social, economic and cultural progress.

verification.evidence: As Head of the Commonwealth, the Sovereign links Canada to 53 other nations that cooperate to advance social, economic and cultural progress. Other constitutional monarchies include Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Australia, New Zealand, The Netherlands, Spain, Thailand, Japan, Jordan and Morocco. … As a constitutional monarchy, Canada’s Head of State is a hereditary Sovereign (Queen or King), who reigns in accordance with the Constitution: the rule of law. … No bill can become law in Canada until it has been passed by both chambers and has received royal assent, granted by the Governor General on behalf of the Sovereign. … There is a clear distinction in Canada between the head of state—the Sovereign—and the head of government—the Prime Minister, who actually directs the governing of the country.
